# plotwork_pattern (Resource)

One of an organisation's approved patterns: a diagram with fixed parts every team draws the same, and `{{slot}}` markers for what each team fills in. Plotwork's agents offer the organisation's patterns first.

`content` is a pattern file, such as `file("${path.module}/payments.pattern.json")`. Its format is described by [the pattern schema](https://docs.plotwork.dev/schemas/plotwork.pattern.json); the Plotwork MCP server's `get_pattern` with `file: true` gives one to start from, and `check_pattern` checks it. Plotwork checks every template before it saves.

Needs the Enterprise plan, and the owner or an admin, or an organisation key with the `design:write` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A pattern file: get_pattern with file = true in the Plotwork MCP server
# gives one to start from, and check_pattern checks it.
resource "plotwork_pattern" "payments" {
  organization = "acme"
  content      = file("${path.module}/patterns/payments-service.pattern.json")
}

# Every pattern file in a folder.
resource "plotwork_pattern" "all" {
  for_each = fileset("${path.module}/patterns/approved", "*.pattern.json")

  organization = "acme"
  content      = file("${path.module}/patterns/approved/${each.value}")
}

# What agents pass to draw_from_pattern.
output "payments_pattern" {
  value = plotwork_pattern.payments.pattern_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The pattern file as JSON text. It is compared as JSON, so spacing and key order are not a change. Its `name` is the pattern's name: changing it replaces the pattern.

### Optional

- `organization` (String) The slug or id of the organisation. Defaults to the provider's `organization` (or `PLOTWORK_ORG`). Changing it, or the provider's value when this is left out, replaces the resource in the new organisation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<organisation>/<name>`.
- `kind` (String) The kind of diagram its templates draw, such as `flow`.
- `name` (String) The pattern's name, read from `content`.
- `pattern_id` (String) What the tools take to draw from it: `org:<name>`, such as in `draw_from_pattern`.
- `title` (String) The pattern's title, as saved.
- `updated_at` (String) When the pattern was last saved, RFC 3339 with milliseconds.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An organisation's pattern, as <organisation>/<name>.
terraform import plotwork_pattern.payments acme/payments-service
```
